purpose: Teach: サンプリング/割愛/懸案/編入/確固たる/バックグラウンド/アウトプット/転嫁

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、薬物のサンプリング検査を強化されますね
lines.en: The police are really strengthening their drug sampling and testing protocols, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, appreciative tone. Light cadence on the observation. Gentle upward inflection at the end—genuinely conversational, not perfunctory. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不要な情報は報告書で割愛されますね
lines.en: The police make sure unnecessary information gets left out of the reports, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful nod in the voice. Slight pause before the key phrase. Tone of understanding operational discretion. Warm approval without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、長期懸案の冤罪事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: And they're taking on those long-standing wrongful conviction cases too, aren't they?
lines.style: Shift to something deeper. Slower pace. Quiet respect. The inflection carries genuine weight—not just listing facts but acknowledging something that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察学校への編入制度もありますね
lines.en: There's even a system for transferring people into the police academy, right?
lines.style: Lighter again. Conversational curiosity. Natural pacing. Like he's learning alongside the listener—surprised by his own discovery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、確固たる証拠を集められますね
lines.en: They really do gather solid evidence carefully, don't they?
lines.style: Affirming tone. Emphasis lands on 'solid'—not rushed. Calm confidence in the words. Trailing breath at the end, like nodding agreement to himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者のバックグラウンドを徹底調査されますね
lines.en: And they conduct thorough background checks on suspects, thoroughly and fairly.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. No breathlessness. Clinical precision balanced with warmth. Speaking from respect for process, not suspicion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査のアウトプットを市民に説明されますね
lines.en: They make sure to explain their investigation findings to the public too.
lines.style: Tone of appreciation for transparency. Moderate pace. Slight lift at the end—approval of accountability. Grounded and genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、責任を被害者に転嫁しない姿勢ですね
lines.en: What strikes me most is they don't shift responsibility onto victims—that's real integrity.
lines.style: Quieter now. Deeper conviction underneath. Slower, choosing words carefully. This one lands with weight. Exhale at the close, like something important was just said.
